name: ADB PD-90
summary: An ADB submachine gun sold at Ammu-Nation for $3,350, according to GTABase.
body: GTABase lists the ADB PD-90 as a SMG weapon made by ADB, with an ammo capacity of 30.
GTABase says it is bought at Ammu-Nation for $3,350 in story mode and can be modified with attachments and tints.
Dexerto's weapon page lists in-game ratings of damage 4.2, accuracy 4.8, handling 6.6 and range 4.2, a 30-round magazine and full auto fire, and calls it an Assault SMG.
Dexerto gives its caliber as 5.7x28mm, full-auto fire, and the maker's full name as Armurerie de Belgique.
A compact personal-defence submachine gun from Armurerie de Belgique (AdB) in 5.7x28mm.
IGN's weapons table (updated November 18, 2026) gives its Ammu-Nation stock as "Expanded Only".
Name disagreement: IGN's table calls this Armurerie De Belgique submachine gun the AdB PD-90 (assault subtype, 5.7x28mm, 30 rounds, full auto).
